medium.zh: 鋼琴獨奏・AI 輔助創作

caption.en: A quiet one-minute winter piano solo paired with a macro study of a single crystalline snowflake resting on frost-dusted ebony and ivory keys.
caption.zh: 一段靜謐的一分鐘冬日純鋼琴獨奏，搭配微距鏡頭下停駐在覆霜黑鍵上的六角雪花結晶，在黑白琴鍵間凝結冬日氣息。

alt.en: Macro photograph of a delicate crystalline snowflake resting upright on a frost-dusted black piano key amid warm ivory keys
alt.zh: 微距攝影：一枚晶瑩細緻的六角雪花靜靜立於覆著微霜的黑色鋼琴鍵上，周圍為柔和景深的象牙白鍵
